description: This file defines the RtfDocumentRenderer class responsible for rendering a MigraDoc document into RTF format. It includes methods for rendering to files, streams, and strings, and handles the creation of RTF headers, font and color tables, styles, and document content sections.

classes.name: RtfDocumentRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a MigraDoc Document into RTF format, managing the RTF header, font/color tables, styles, and document content.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a Document object to a specified file path with a working directory.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a Document object to a stream, with an option to close the stream afterward, using a working directory.

methods.name: RenderToString
methods.description: Renders a Document to RTF and returns it as a string.

methods.name: WriteDocument
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual rendering of the document to RTF, including handling embedded files, flattening, and header rendering.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares font and color tables for RTF header, collecting used fonts and colors from the document.

methods.name: GetPredefinedFontNames
methods.description: Returns a collection of predefined font names used in RTF creation.

methods.name: RenderHeader
methods.description: Renders the RTF document header, including font, color, styles, and list tables.

methods.name: CollectTables
methods.description: Recursively collects fonts, colors, and list information from the document's objects for header table creation.

methods.name: RenderFontTable
methods.description: Outputs the font table in the RTF header based on the collected fonts.

methods.name: RenderColorTable
methods.description: Outputs the color table in the RTF header based on the collected colors.

methods.name: GetFontIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a font name in the font table.

methods.name: GetColorIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a color in the color table.

methods.name: GetStyleIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the style index by style name.

methods.name: RenderStyles
methods.description: Renders all document styles into the RTF header.

methods.name: RenderListTable
methods.description: Outputs list information (including overrides) for the document.

methods.name: RenderDocumentArea
methods.description: Renders the main document content excluding the header.

methods.name: RenderGlobalPorperties
methods.description: Sets global properties like mirror margins, Unicode handling, etc.

methods.name: RenderDocumentFormat
methods.description: Outputs formatting settings like tab stops and footnotes.

methods.name: RenderSectionProperties
methods.description: Outputs footnote-specific section properties.

methods.name: RenderInfo
methods.description: Outputs document metadata such as title, author, keywords.
